name: Madremanya (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the white open hand of the arms.
history: The flag was approved on 2 July 2003 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3938 of 1 August 2003, with a correction published on 1 December 2004; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with the white hand of the arms, 4/6 of the height, at the centre.
